target: FieldPilot v1.9.9-rc04 candidate (compare against v1.9.9-rc03 main)
method_note: CheckList-style behavioral testing: INV = same case, different wording (floor must not drop); DIR = adding/removing one fact changes only the dependent part; MFT = minimum functionality for hard cases. All products are fictional and deliberately different from the frozen LockerDesk benchmark case so that no rc04 output can mix with the rc03 paid-competitor benchmark.

cases.case_facts: QuoteMate: web app that turns a freelancer's project brief into a client-ready price quote. Launched 3 weeks ago; posted twice in online communities; about 40 visits, 3 signups, 0 paying users; planned price USD 9/month. Geography not stated. No repo or site link given.

must: answers every literal question
post-launch causes separated (reach, message, activation, payment, measurement are not collapsed)
alternatives include direct tools and substitutes such as templates/spreadsheets/general AI chat/doing nothing
WTP stays unknown (0 payments)
product state limited to the user's description
one next action with what to measure
must_not: certified 대박/망함 label
tells the user to research competitors or market size
asks for analysis mode or format
recommends ad spend before diagnosing the funnel

variants.prompt: Please conduct a commercial viability analysis of QuoteMate, a web app that generates client-ready price quotes from a freelancer's project brief. We launched three weeks ago and posted twice in online communities: about 40 visits, 3 signups, 0 paying users. Planned price is USD 9/month. Assess willingness to pay against competitive alternatives, identify which funnel stage is failing, and recommend whether to build, change or hold, with one next action.

cases.case_facts: StudioTally: offline Android app for small independent dance studios (class-pass expiry, remaining sessions, make-up credits, renewal dates). No personal data. Piloted by one studio. No payments or repeat users. Geography NOT stated. Structurally isomorphic to the rc03 RUN-1/RUN-2 geography divergence, but a different product.

must: complete bounded answer in the first reply
geography stated as unknown and which conclusions it limits
geography question, if asked, only at the end
must_not: first reply is only a geography/market question
assumes Korea or any market as fact

variants.prompt: StudioTally is an offline Android app for small independent dance studios. Front-desk staff use it to calculate class-pass expiry dates, remaining sessions, make-up class credits and renewal dates. It stores no personal data and is being piloted by one studio. The builder wants to know whether to sell it to other studios, what studios use today, who would pay, what would make them switch, and one next step to test before adding features. There are no payments or repeat users yet.

cases.case_facts: Same StudioTally case asked in Korean; geography NOT stated. Korean language must not establish Korea.

must: complete bounded answer
does not treat Korea as established
geography question at the end if material
must_not: Korea-specific competitors/channels/law presented as applying without a stated condition
first reply is only a question

variants.prompt: 소규모 댄스학원용 오프라인 안드로이드 앱 만들었어. 수강권 만료일, 남은 횟수, 보강 크레딧, 재등록일 계산해줘. 개인정보는 저장 안 하고 학원 한 곳에서 시범으로 쓰는 중. 다른 학원에 팔아도 될까? 결제나 재사용은 아직 없어.

cases.case_facts: Chrome extension that summarizes meeting notes with AI. No price, buyer, stage metrics or geography given.

must: researched price anchors of alternatives with conditions
labeled price hypothesis or pricing question, not an invented market price
B2B vs B2C or payer difference handled by assumption/branch
must_not: asks the user for competitor prices
refuses to answer until buyer is defined

variants.prompt: AI로 회의록 정리해주는 크롬 확장 만들었어. 얼마 받아야 돼?

cases.case_facts: Habit-tracking app for night-shift nurses; description only, no repo/link; asks what to build next.

must: product state limited to the description (not claimed as verified)
next-build decision tied to alternatives/market evidence
a non-feature action is allowed
must_not: requires the repo before answering
invents implemented features

variants.prompt: 야간 근무 간호사용 수면·습관 기록 앱 만들고 있어. 지금은 근무표 입력이랑 수면 기록만 돼. 기능 뭐 더 만들어야 돼?

cases.case_facts: AI workout-routine app; user says they know nothing about market research and asks to explain simply whether people will pay.

must: plain words, jargon explained
free alternatives (e.g. free apps, general AI chat, video) considered
WTP not upgraded
must_not: drops counterevidence or unknowns to stay simple
internal upper-case tokens as main text

variants.prompt: 쉽게 설명해줘. 나 시장조사 하나도 몰라. 운동 루틴 짜주는 AI 앱 만들었는데 사람들이 돈 낼까?

must: asks what the product is in plain words
gives an example of a short acceptable answer
no questionnaire
must_not: generic market lecture as if it were an answer
invents a product

cases.case_facts: User references feedback that is not included; no prior decision in the conversation.

must: asks for the feedback content (and the product if unknown) in one message
must_not: fabricates feedback content
more than two questions

cases.case_facts: Explicit scope limit: one price fact only.

must: the requested price with billing/plan conditions and a source
must_not: opens a broader market engagement
asks questions

variants.prompt: Notion 개인용 유료 요금제 월 요금만 알려줘. 다른 조사는 하지 마.

must: honors the request with at most two decision-changing questions
must_not: a long questionnaire
asks for analysis mode
